fact: The Division spéciale de cybersécurité is governed by the cybercrime law promulgated on 25 January 2008, and its referrals include the commentator Badara Gadiaga, held under a committal order on 14 July 2025 and prosecuted for spreading false news, among other charges.
title: Division spéciale de cybersécurité : Police des réseaux sociaux, gardien des mœurs
